name: Tide of Voices
main_idea: Viewer chat becomes a luminous tide that the streamer surfs safely to shore.
model_description: Wave made of glyph tiles; surfboard of light; shoreline stage.
environment_description: Scene transforms from chatroom to ocean of text (water metaphor).
voice_effects: chorus of processed viewer snippets (privacy-safe tones)
ai_reaction: AI acknowledges 'Tide of Voices' with a rarity-appropriate line and never fabricates delivery.
streamer_reaction: Streamer avatar/emote hook on arrival + optional thank-you prompt.
avatar_reaction: Avatar glance/emote timed to completion hook.
viewer_reaction: Viewer-side fullscreen or scoped effect per rarity.
chat_reaction: Chat system message with gift name, sender, and rarity badge.
combo_reaction: Combination id sylora.gift.tide-of-voices with window based on rarity.
mobile_lod: reduced particles, simplified materials, no motion blur
desktop_ultra: full particles, HDR, bloom, DoF, motion blur when specified
known_limitations: Specification only until Blender/GLB/audio/preview/runtime evidence is produced and verified.
